en: Hand‑colored vintage postcard showing an elegant, long pavilion-style café set in manicured gardens with flowerbeds and outdoor seating. People in early 20th‑century clothing sit at tables under a decorative colonnade and on the lawn. Forested hills rise in the background. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Café Kaiserpark in Karlsbad, and the printer's credit appears in small text.
